reason: The report concludes 'no effect' from a single non-significant estimate (coef -0.306, SE 0.225, p = 0.175; my re-run reproduces this with 95% CI roughly [-0.75, 0.14]), which is absence of evidence rather than evidence of no effect, and the CI includes large negative effects. In addition, remote_share is standardized-looking (about half the values are negative, range -2.97 to 3.87), so it is not a valid 0-1 'share' as the codebook describes, and the conclusion rests on one unvalidated specification.
